name: Naganohara (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Naganohara town emblem in white: a thin ring enclosing a stylised bird-like device with a peaked crest.
history: Municipal flag of Naganohara, a town in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 1970.

features.role: Naganohara town emblem — a thin ring enclosing a stylised bird-like device with a peaked crest
